note: Wisconsin's oldest state park, on the Dalles of the St. Croix opposite Taylors Falls, MN. The North campground beside the river has the electric sites and showers; the rustic South campground lies about 1.7 km away by the Lake O' the Dalles swimming beach. The water systems shut down for winter; the dump stays open into late November. --Claude
